select systemMessage.id, systemMessage.main_title, systemMessage.sub_title, systemMessage.message_type, systemMessage.detail_url, systemMessage.message_person, systemMessage.content, systemMessage.status, systemMessage.remark, systemMessage.organization_id, systemMessage.department_id, systemMessage.tenant_id, systemMessage.revision, systemMessage.created_by, systemMessage.created_time, systemMessage.updated_by, systemMessage.updated_time, systemMessage.deleted_by, systemMessage.deleted_time, systemMessage.deleted_flag, systemMessage.created_name as createdName from system_message as systemMessage
systemMessage.deleted_flag = 'N' and systemMessage.main_title like concat('%', #{mainTitle}, '%')
and systemMessage.sub_title like concat('%', #{subTitle}, '%')
and systemMessage.message_type = #{messageType} and systemMessage.message_person = #{messagePerson}
and systemMessage.detail_url = #{detailUrl} and systemMessage.content like concat('%', #{content}, '%')
and systemMessage.status = #{status} and systemMessage.remark like concat('%', #{remark}, '%') and systemMessage.created_name like concat('%', #{createdName}, '%')
and
( systemMessage.remark like concat('%', #{item}, '%') or systemMessage.main_title like concat('%', #{item}, '%') or systemMessage.sub_title like concat('%', #{item}, '%') or systemMessage.content like concat('%', #{item}, '%') )
order by systemMessage.created_time desc

select systemMessage.id, systemMessage.main_title, systemMessage.sub_title, systemMessage.message_type, systemMessage.detail_url, systemMessage.content, systemMessage.status, systemMessage.remark, systemMessage.organization_id, systemMessage.department_id, systemMessage.tenant_id, systemMessage.revision, systemMessage.created_by, systemMessage.created_time, systemMessage.updated_by, systemMessage.updated_time, systemMessage.deleted_by, systemMessage.deleted_time, systemMessage.deleted_flag, mus.status as readStatus, systemMessage.created_name as createdName from system_message as systemMessage left join system_message_user as mus on mus.message_id = systemMessage.id
systemMessage.deleted_flag = 'N' and (mus.user_id = #{userId} and mus.deleted_flag = 'N') and systemMessage.message_type = #{messageType} and (mus.status = #{status} or mus.status is null ) and mus.status = #{status}
and
( systemMessage.main_title like concat('%', #{item}, '%') or systemMessage.sub_title like concat('%', #{item}, '%') or systemMessage.content like concat('%', #{item}, '%') or systemMessage.remark like concat('%', #{item}, '%') )
order by systemMessage.created_time desc
